items.stem: A sketch for a bracket profile is left under-constrained. When a colleague edits a dimension upstream, the profile geometry shifts in an unexpected way. What is the lesson?

options.text: Fully constraining sketches preserves design intent so edits behave predictably
options.rationale: Correct: a fully constrained sketch locks geometry so parametric edits update as intended.

options.text: Sketches should always be left under-constrained for flexibility
options.rationale: Under-constrained sketches move unpredictably; that is the problem here.

options.text: Dimensions should never be edited after sketching
options.rationale: Editing dimensions is normal; the fix is constraining the sketch.

options.text: The part must be remodelled from scratch each time
options.rationale: Remodelling defeats the purpose of a parametric workflow.

items.explanation: Correct: a fully constrained sketch locks geometry so parametric edits update as intended.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO are advantages of driving a model from a parameter table? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Key dimensions can be changed in one place and propagate through the model
options.rationale: Correct: central parameters make coordinated edits fast and consistent.

options.text: Design intent and relationships between dimensions are captured explicitly
options.rationale: Correct: parameters record the relationships the designer intends.

options.text: It prevents the model from ever being edited
options.rationale: Parameters make editing easier, not impossible.

options.text: It removes the need for any sketch constraints
options.rationale: Sketch constraints are still needed for robust geometry.

items.explanation: Correct: central parameters make coordinated edits fast and consistent.

items.stem: A manufacturing drawing dimensions a shaft-and-hole mating pair but shows no tolerances. Why is this a problem for manufacture?

options.text: Without tolerances the shop cannot know the allowable variation for a proper fit
options.rationale: Correct: tolerances define the permitted variation needed to achieve the intended fit.

options.text: Tolerances are only decorative and never affect fit
options.rationale: Tolerances directly control whether mating parts fit.

options.text: A drawing should never include tolerances
options.rationale: Manufacturing drawings require tolerances on controlled dimensions.

options.text: The part cannot have mating features
options.rationale: Mating features are common; they specifically need tolerances.

items.explanation: Correct: tolerances define the permitted variation needed to achieve the intended fit.
